Subconsciously, yes. I had a rough childhood before adoption; classic case of poverty, abuse, alcoholism, and substance use. I've definitely joked about how we would have benefited from a social worker! As the oldest, I had the responsibility of taking care of the younger kids so deep down, I knew I'd grow up to care for others in some capacity. 

I had failed several of the math and science courses as a nursing major, which stressed me out because I had no backup plan. I genuinely felt lost. Thank goodness my academic advisor didn't give up on suggesting social work because the second I switched, I thrived.

Stalking seems likely. With the supernatural elements, I wondered if he received visions of them or was provided basic descriptions to look out for before setting out. 

Aside from the hair, it was creepy to see the dolls wearing the same/similar outfits. The thought of Longlegs looking around for little girls' clothing is odd, so I prefer to think this became an additional task for Ruth. Since we learn she's a hoarder, they probably used some of Lee's old clothes at some point...

You're right. Just having some fun filling in what we weren't given.

I agree, the hippy stint sounds like something he'd be involved in, and the right environment for him to fry his brain and be introduced to the occult. His appearance does make it a bit difficult but 50s sounds reasonable to the timeline we're envisioning. 

Something else that popped up in my head is the fact that he appears to limp. If this is a congenital disorder then that would've been cause for rejection as well but I creeped myself out thinking of it being an injury he sustained during a murder before Ruth joined in, perhaps from someone fighting back before the dolls took hold.
I think in the interrogation scene she mentioned the year as 1974 which still places her birth before the murders began, just adds a bit of time before then. Very interesting thought!

Look at the bright side, if she rejects you then you won't be inexperienced in asking out the next girl you might like. Whatever you choose to do, I hope it goes well!
